node.title: Prize-field-floor exclusion for even low-square-mass E1 norms
node.statement: On every pair-feasible prize-envelope prime row, the exact field floor is p>2^255. Every nonzero same-size E1 class-difference norm is even. The folded L2 bound is at most 2^256 for N=256,S<=16 and N=512,S<=4; divisibility by odd p would force the norm to equal p, a contradiction. Hence the prize-row live floors sharpen to S>=18 and S>=6 respectively. RowC is unchanged.
node.notes: ROW-SPECIFIC EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: spends the exact prize interval rather than the common p>=2^250 floor and removes the maximal-weight profiles from the binding aggregate budget.
